quests.title: Good as New

dialogue.t: Hello, Traveler, Paimon. I've heard that you've been participating in the Fecund Hamper event. Was it fun?
It's been pretty fun! Paimon isn't sure if it's because there was this market during Weinlesefest, but we got all sorts of decorations.
Haha, there are indeed people who would prepare those as gifts. Right, since we're running a snack shop, do you want to put some of those decorations here?
Prettying the shop up could help us attract more customers.
Besides, I'm sure the gift givers would be happy to see their sincere gifts being used in your shop.
Good point! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's decorate our shop!

quests.description: Bernhard has heard that you are participating in the Fecund Hamper event…
